elements.name: q_1
elements.title: When is extended audio description required?
choices: When foreground-audio pauses are insufficient to convey the sense of the video

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: How does an extended version make time for description?
choices: It pauses the presentation and resumes afterward

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Why is “diagram changes” potentially insufficient?
choices: It may omit meaningful changes and relationships

answer_key.q_1: When foreground-audio pauses are insufficient to convey the sense of the video
answer_key.q_2: It pauses the presentation and resumes afterward
answer_key.q_3: It may omit meaningful changes and relationships

explanations.q_1: The criterion addresses insufficient pauses for necessary descriptions.
explanations.q_2: Pausing creates space for the description.
explanations.q_3: An adequate description communicates the sense of the visual content.
